tasks.prompt: You are a member of your university’s hiking club and have volunteered to arrange hotel accommodations for the club's upcoming trip to Green Mountain. There are fifteen to twenty people in your group, and you will need to check out at 4 a.m. to start hiking. Another member has recommended Green Mountain Inn, where he has stayed before.
bullets: ●  Explain how you heard about the inn.
●  Ask for availability and room rates.
tasks.subject: Weekend trip planning

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the concept of universal basic income (UBI), where all citizens receive a regular, unconditional sum of money from the government. Some economists believe UBI can reduce poverty and stimulate economic growth, while others argue it may discourage people from working and contributing to society. What are your thoughts on implementing universal basic income? Would it be beneficial or harmful? Please explain.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think UBI would be beneficial. It would provide financial security for everyone, especially the most vulnerable. It could help reduce poverty and give people the freedom to pursue education and entrepreneurial activities without the constant stress of financial instability.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: In my opinion, UBI might be harmful. It could reduce the incentive for people to work and contribute to the economy. Additionally, funding such a program could require significant tax increases, which might negatively impact economic growth.
